key.name: skin
key.description: Which UI variant and stylesheet the bridge uses for its panels. Themes set it in their look module (desk.dconf).

key.name: language
key.description: 'system' follows the session locale (LANGUAGE, LC_MESSAGES); 'uk' or 'en' overrides it for desktop-themes-rs only (the window, the themes command, deskd and desk-bridge).

key.name: enabled
key.description: Turn off to disable the feature completely

key.name: history-size
key.description: How many unpinned items to keep

key.name: persist-images
key.description: Off by default: images live only in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR while the session runs.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste the selected item into the focused window
key.description: After you choose an item it is pasted into the window you were working in

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the clipboard panel (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default here from desk.dconf (Super+V for Windows 11, Shift+Super+V for macOS); an override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts clipboard-toggle replaces it and is re-applied after every theme apply. Change it in the window (Keyboard shortcuts) or with `themes shortcut`.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: Applications whose copies are never recorded (WM class or app id)

key.name: clipboard-toggle
key.summary: Your shortcut for the clipboard panel (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.
